title: CAM Core Parameter Catalog — Drilling, 2D, 3D Cycle Params ~2,500 Schemas
description: Generate parameter schemas for the largest domain: core CAM cycle parameters. Covers drilling cycles (15+ types, ~450 params), 2D cycles (12+ types, ~600 params), 3D cycles (20+ types, ~950 params), and shared cutting data parameters (spindle speed, feed rate, feed per tooth across all cycle types ~500 params). Each parameter gets physics mapping to KienzleForceModel, SpeedFeedOrchestrator, or ChatterStabilityLobeEngine. This is the backbone of PRISM's hyperMILL optimization capability.

forge_triple.hook: camCoreParameterPhysicsValidator — BUILT — validates cutting data against Kienzle force limits
forge_triple.action: generate_cam_core_catalog — BUILT — generates CAM core domain artifacts from schemas
forge_triple.skill: /hypermill-cam-core-params — BUILT — core CAM parameter reference with physics-backed recommendations

sessions.title: Drilling Cycle Parameter Schemas (~450 params)
knowledge: 15+ drilling cycle types: spot, peck, deep, gun, bore, ream, tap, thread mill, countersink, etc.
L/D ratio safety rules, peck depth formulas, tap feed synchronization
sessions.intent: Generate complete parameter schemas for all drilling cycle types. Each cycle has cutting data (8-12 fields), geometry (5-10), heights (6-8), passes (8-15), tool compensation (3-5), coolant (2-4). Critical hooks for L/D ratio, peck depth, and tap feed sync.

units.title: Drilling Cycle Schemas — 15+ cycle types, ~450 parameters
units.description: Generate Zod schemas for all drilling cycle parameters across 15+ types (spot drill, peck drill, deep hole drill, gun drill, boring, reaming, tapping, thread milling, countersink, counterbore, back spot face, helical bore, circular pocket drill, chamfer drill, combined cycles). Each type gets full parameter set: cutting data, geometry/boundary, heights/clearance, passes/strategy, tool compensation, coolant. L/D ratio blocking hook, peck depth formula hook, tap feed synchronization hook.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: >= 15 drilling cycle types with complete parameter schemas
>= 400 total drilling parameters across all types
L/D ratio hook blocks when hole depth/diameter > 10 without pecking
Tap feed sync hook validates feed = 1/pitch for rigid tapping
Unit tests for peck drill, tapping, and gun drill parameter schemas

sessions.exit_gate: ✓ >= 400 drilling params | ✓ L/D + peck + tap hooks | omega_floor >= 0.90

sessions.title: 2D Cycle Parameter Schemas (~600 params)
knowledge: 12+ 2D cycle types: pocket, contour, face, slot, chamfer, T-slot, plunge, rest, engrave, etc.
Pocket depth engagement rules, contour approach strategies
sessions.intent: Generate schemas for all 2D cycle parameters. Includes pocket (stepdown, stepover, direction), contour (offset, lead-in/out), face milling, slot, chamfer, T-slot, plunge roughing, rest machining, engraving. Hooks for pocket depth engagement and 2D rest material tool change.

units.title: 2D Pocket + Contour + Face Schemas — ~350 parameters
units.description: Generate schemas for the 3 most common 2D cycle families: pocket (stepdown, stepover, ramp angle, multiple depths, rest machining, island detection, direction, tolerance), contour (offset, approach type, lead-in arc/line, overcut, approach/retract), and face milling (width, overlap, direction, step pattern). Each with full cutting data, geometry, heights, passes, tool comp, coolant parameter sets.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Pocket schema: >= 60 parameters including ramp angle and rest machining
Contour schema: >= 50 parameters including approach strategy
Face mill schema: >= 35 parameters including overlap and direction
Pocket depth engagement hook validates ap vs tool diameter ratio
Unit tests for pocket stepdown range and contour lead-in validation

units.title: 2D Slot + Chamfer + T-Slot + Plunge + Rest + Engrave Schemas — ~250 parameters
units.description: Generate schemas for remaining 2D cycle types: slot milling (width, depth, single/multi-pass), chamfering (angle, width, depth), T-slot (neck width, head width, depth, approach), plunge roughing (plunge feed, retract, overlap), rest machining (previous tool reference, stock model update), engraving (depth, character spacing, font, angle). Rest machining tool change hook validates new tool < previous tool diameter.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: >= 6 additional 2D cycle types with complete schemas
>= 230 parameters across slot, chamfer, T-slot, plunge, rest, engrave
Rest machining tool change hook validates diameter step-down
Unit tests for T-slot approach validation and plunge feed limits

sessions.exit_gate: ✓ >= 580 2D params across 12+ types | ✓ pocket depth + rest material hooks | omega_floor >= 0.90

sessions.title: 3D Cycle Parameter Schemas (~950 params)
knowledge: 20+ 3D cycle types: Z-level, parallel, scallop, pencil, rest, MAXX offset, MAXX HPC, optimized, etc.
Scallop height formulas, thermal constraints, deflection limits
sessions.intent: Generate schemas for all 3D cycle parameters. Z-level (stepdown, scallop height, wall finish), parallel (stepover, angle, tolerance), scallop (cusp height, adaptive), pencil (corner radius detection), rest machining cascade, MAXX cycles (HPC engagement, offset strategy). Hooks for scallop height prediction, thermal deflection, and MAXX engagement angle.

units.title: 3D Z-Level + Parallel + Scallop + Pencil Schemas — ~500 parameters
units.description: Generate schemas for primary 3D cycle types: Z-level roughing/finishing (stepdown, wall finish passes, steep/shallow threshold, area selection), parallel finishing (stepover, cutting angle, tolerance, bidirectional/unidirectional), scallop finishing (cusp height target, adaptive stepover, curvature-driven), pencil finishing (corner radius detection, blend radius, rest detection). Scallop height prediction hook computes ae from R and target Ra.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Z-level schema: >= 65 parameters with steep/shallow threshold
Parallel schema: >= 55 parameters with angle optimization
Scallop schema: >= 45 parameters with adaptive stepover
Pencil schema: >= 35 parameters with corner detection
Scallop height hook: validates ae vs target Ra using R-sqrt(R²-(ae/2)²) formula
Unit tests for scallop height computation and Z-level stepdown limits

units.title: 3D Rest + MAXX + Optimized + Advanced Schemas — ~450 parameters
units.description: Generate schemas for advanced 3D cycle types: rest roughing (previous tool ref, stock model cascade, tool diameter step-down), rest finishing (from previous finishing tool), MAXX offset roughing (engagement angle, HSC mode, optimal load), MAXX HPC roughing (high-performance cutting, radial engagement), optimized roughing (adaptive stepover, trochoidal), and additional 3D types (flowline, geodesic, morphed). MAXX engagement angle hook and thermal constraint hook.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Rest machining schemas: >= 80 parameters with cascade validation
MAXX cycle schemas: >= 60 parameters with engagement angle limits
Optimized/advanced schemas: >= 100 parameters
MAXX engagement angle hook limits ae to manufacturer recommendations
Thermal constraint hook flags high-speed operations exceeding temperature threshold
Total 3D domain reaches >= 900 parameter schemas

sessions.exit_gate: ✓ >= 900 3D params across 20+ types | ✓ scallop height + MAXX engagement + thermal hooks | omega_floor >= 0.90

sessions.title: Shared Cutting Data Schemas + CAM Core Artifact Batch Generation
knowledge: Shared cutting data fields across all cycle types (spindle speed, feed rate, feed per tooth)
sessions.intent: Generate schemas for shared cutting data parameters that apply across all cycle types, tool compensation, and coolant. Then batch-generate all CAM core artifacts (skills, scripts, hooks) from the complete ~2,500 parameter catalog.

units.title: Shared Cutting Data + Tool Comp + Coolant Schemas — ~500 parameters
units.description: Generate schemas for cross-cycle cutting data parameters (spindle_speed, feed_rate, feed_per_tooth, plunge_feed, ramp_feed, retract_feed, approach_feed, lead_in_feed, finishing_feed — per cycle type), tool compensation parameters (comp_type none/computer/wear/reverse, comp_direction left/right, comp_register — per cycle type), and coolant parameters (coolant_mode flood/mist/through/air/off, coolant_pressure, coolant_override — per cycle type). Physics mapping links each to SpeedFeedOrchestrator.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Cutting data schemas: >= 360 parameters (8-12 fields × 40+ cycle types)
Tool compensation schemas: >= 120 parameters across all cycle types
Coolant schemas: >= 80 parameters across all cycle types
Each cutting data parameter maps to SpeedFeedOrchestratorEngine resolver
Unit tests validate feed rate range for 3 material groups (P, M, K)

units.title: CAM Core Artifact Batch Generation — ~2,500 skills + scripts + hooks
units.description: Artifact generation engine for the entire CAM core domain. Reads all ~2,500 parameter schemas (drilling + 2D + 3D + shared cutting data + tool comp + coolant) and auto-generates skill templates with physics-backed recommendations, AC Python setter scripts, and hook validation rules. Registers all safety hooks. This is the single largest generation run in the HM-KC track.

exit_criteria: Skill templates generated for all ~2,500 CAM core parameters
AC Python setter scripts generated for all ~2,500 CAM core parameters
>= 15 safety hooks registered for CAM core (L/D, peck, tap sync, pocket depth, scallop, MAXX, thermal, feed limits)
tsc --noEmit passes with 0 errors on all generated artifacts
